name: Digambar Jain Terah Panth Kothi
why_pick: Largest dharamshala in Madhuban — 400+ rooms inside the trust compound, a few minutes' walk from the Tonk-1 trail-head where the 27km Jal Mandir circumambulation begins. Pilgrims roll out at 3-4am without arranging transport.
what_to_know: In-house Jain bhojanshala runs fixed thali timings (no eating after sunset per Digambar discipline). Reserve in advance — 400 rooms still fill during Kartik Purnima and Mahavir Jayanti. Phone 06558-232231 / 232292.
best_for: Pilgrims doing the full Tonk circumambulation; first-time Shikharji visitors who want the trail-head walk
address_or_landmark: Madhuban, Parasnath, Giridih — within the Digambar Jain trust precinct, near the Tonk-1 trail-head
